scope: One local Auth epoch dispatch/settlement fence: synchronously publish the existing opaque epoch before scheduling its React state update, and skip selected-resource effects/settlements whose captured epoch is already obsolete. No Auth event or invalidation rule is removed.
hypothesis: An Auth notification can precede a newly mounted selected effect while its rendered context still contains the previous epoch. A synchronous local epoch check avoids the obsolete request; the following committed scope still sends a fresh live-authorized GET. Preserve Phase11 module boundaries and quantify their unresolved Settings/first-use costs.
constraints: No successful authorization/data cache, auth-event suppression, unverified identity authority, GET transport/query/policy change, production configuration/schema/index/dependency changes or publication. Phase10 fonts and Phase11 code deferral retained.
profiles: 80ms latency, 200000 B/s down, 93750 B/s up, CPU4x

deferredFeatureCost.readiness: Settings actual public-profile form, fixture meeting data, empty scheduled list after fetch, and anonymous-review controls. Anonymous review uses its existing Settings/Application link; warm return uses browser history. Decisions group/details summary open before timed action.

pilot: One baseline/candidate constrained main-path protocol sanity probe, four outcomes each (eight total); excluded whole. Additional untimed HTML/SSR observations, if collected, remain diagnostic only.
newRegressionCoverage: Auth epoch fence changes synchronously before React commits; stale rendered effects dispatch no request; obsolete successful/error settlements cannot commit while a new Auth context is pending. Real constrained entry/revisit/revocation plus 67 live cases including the new case, plus existing navigation/draft/transport/privacy/native suites.
primaryMetric: Full preceding source document useful-content time plus captured requests/script/body bytes and separate subsequent click timing. No readiness clock change. Bounded drains, incomplete background transport flags, fonts/FCP/CLS retained.
power: Temporary caffeinate -dimsu; complete actual power audit; exclude interrupted set whole.
publication: Local experiment only; preserve Phase11 adverse evidence and investigate remaining Settings/anonymous-review and server tails before any publication.
